 (SELECT pp.deadline_ms FROM route_assignments ra JOIN policy_profiles pp ON pp.profile_id=ra.profile_id WHERE ra.route_id=lo.route_id AND ra.effective_from_ms<=lo.opened_at_ms AND ra.effective_to_ms>lo.opened_at_ms) dl
 FROM logical_operations lo JOIN service_routes sr ON sr.route_id=lo.route_id AND sr.service_id=2 JOIN att ON att.operation_id=lo.operation_id
 WHERE lo.opened_at_ms>=1778148000000 AND lo.opened_at_ms<1778155200000)
SELECT o.period, w.pool_code, COUNT(*) ops, SUM(CASE WHEN fc.is_success=0 AND a.attempt_no=f.mx THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) tf,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN fc.is_success=0 AND a.attempt_no=f.mx THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),4) tfpct,
 SUM(o.natt) att, SUM(CASE WHEN fc.is_success=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) fa,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN fc.is_success=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/SUM(o.natt),4) afpct,

 ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN fc.is_success=0 AND a.attempt_no=f.mx THEN a.execution_ms END),3) efail

),
agg AS (
 SELECT o.pool_id, CASE WHEN o.opened_at_ms<1778151600000 THEN '10:00-11:00' ELSE '11:00-12:00' END period,
   COUNT(*) operations,
   SUM(CASE WHEN f.is_success=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) terminal_failures,
   SUM(CASE WHEN o.nattempts>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) retried_operations,
   SUM(f.attempts) attempts, SUM(f.failed_attempts) failed_attempts,
   MIN(o.deadline_ms) min_deadline_ms, MAX(o.deadline_ms) max_deadline_ms,
   AVG(CASE WHEN f.is_success=0 THEN f.queue_ms END) failed_terminal_queue_mean_ms,
   AVG(CASE WHEN f.is_success=0 THEN f.execution_ms END) failed_terminal_execution_mean_ms
 FROM ops o
 JOIN (SELECT operation_id, MAX(attempt_no) last_no, COUNT(*) attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN c.is_success=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) failed_attempts
       FROM attempt_events a JOIN failure_codes c ON c.code_id=a.code_id GROUP BY operation_id) t ON t.operation_id=o.operation_id
 JOIN attempt_events f ON f.operation_id=o.operation_id AND f.attempt_no=t.last_no
 JOIN failure_codes fcc ON fcc.code_id=f.code_id
 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT a.period, p.pool_code, operations, terminal_failures, 100.0*terminal_failures/operations terminal_failure_pct,
 attempts, failed_attempts, 100.0*failed_attempts/attempts attempt_failure_pct, retried_operations,
 min_deadline_ms, max_deadline_ms, failed_terminal_queue_mean_ms, failed_terminal_execution_mean_ms
FROM agg a JOIN worker_pools p ON p.pool_id=a.pool_id ORDER BY 2,1;
"

FROM (
 SELECT o.pool_id, CASE WHEN o.opened_at_ms<1778151600000 THEN '10:00-11:00' ELSE '11:00-12:00' END period,
   COUNT(*) operations,
   SUM(CASE WHEN fc.is_success=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) terminal_failures,

 JOIN failure_codes fc ON fc.code_id=fa.code_id
 GROUP BY 1,2) a JOIN worker_pools p ON p.pool_id=a.pool_id ORDER BY 2,1;
"
